title: Design federated collection protocol (CollectionItem)
description: A generic ActivityPub extension for curated personal collections of any type — books, records, rocks, stamps, fountain pens, pigeons, anything. Items reference Wikidata for type taxonomy and property schemas. Shelves are named groupings. Reviews/ratings attach to items. Acquisition metadata tracks provenance. Federation lets you follow someone's collection and see new additions in your feed.
design: Core types: CollectionItem (name, category wikidata URI, image, free-form properties, acquired date), Shelf (named grouping), Review/Rating (opinion on item), Acquisition (provenance: bought/found/gifted/traded, date, source). Federation: items are AP objects, adding to a shelf is a Create activity, reviews are Note objects with inReplyTo pointing at the item. Wikidata category URI is the interop key — clients can render any item generically (name+image+rating) or with type-specific UI when they recognize the category.
notes: The media review protocol (smallhold-enxt) is a subset of this. That issue covers books/albums/movies; this covers the general case where the item type is arbitrary and the schema comes from Wikidata rather than hardcoded fields. Key insight: don't build an ontology, reference Wikidata (wd:Q46335 = fountain pen, wd:Q7946 = mineral, etc.). Properties are free-form per item, category URI tells clients how to render. A birding client and a pen client show different property editors but share the same wire protocol.
